D: A stolen diamond, a crooked boxing promoter and a dog all collide in London's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when Mickey knocks out Gorgeous George.
S: minced beef pastries, buttery potato, herb sauce, chilli vinegar

Little minced beef and onion pies with a flaky lid, a scoop of buttery mash and bright green parsley liquor, with chilli vinegar to splash on. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, add 1 tbsp flour and 200ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes, then cool. Line 8 muffin holes with shortcrust, fill and top with puff. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Mash 800g potatoes with 50g butter. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml stock and simmer, then add a bunch of finely chopped parsley. Serve with malt vinegar and chilli.
Cheddar, Red Leicester and Wensleydale diamonds with crackers and pickled onions
Aged cheddar, red Leicester and a crumbly Wensleydale cut into sharp little diamond shapes, with crackers and pickled onions.
Browned chipolatas glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard, on toothpicks
Thin pork sausages grilled until sticky, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard, served on toothpicks.
M: Bacon, sausage, eggs, black pudding, beans, tomato and toast
Grill 8 rashers bacon and 8 pork sausages, fry 4 eggs, 4 slices black pudding and 200g mushrooms, warm 1 tin baked beans, grill 2 halved tomatoes and serve with 8 slices buttered toast.
Sirloin seared medium rare, creamed spinach, baked potato

Thick sirloin seared hard and rested, with a buttery baked potato, garlicky creamed spinach and a sharp horseradish cream, the way Avi orders back home. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 thick sirloins and sear in a smoking pan 3 to 4 minutes a side to 54C inside, then rest. Wilt 400g spinach with a crushed garlic clove, add 150ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce until thick. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish. Split the potatoes, add butter and serve with the steak.
W: Caramel and banana on a biscuit crust under whipped cream
Biscuit base, thick caramel and sliced bananas under a mountain of cream and grated chocolate.
K: Irish whiskey, lime and ginger beer over ice

Irish whiskey over ice topped with fiery ginger beer and fresh lime, with a long ginger and lime garnish. A proper fighter's drink. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Irish whiskey and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.
